name: @abderrahimgazali/hivemind
description: Bridge between Claude Code and Codex for second-opinion and brainstorming workflows

scripts.build:cli: mkdir -p dist && bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target bun && bun build src/daemon.ts --outfile dist/daemon.js --target bun && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.build:plugin: mkdir -p plugins/hivemind/server && bun build src/bridge.ts --outfile plugins/hivemind/server/bridge.js --target bun && bun build src/daemon.ts --outfile plugins/hivemind/server/daemon.js --target bun
scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:plugin
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
